title: How to Cancel Les Mills NZ Membership — Step-by-Step 2026
meta_desc: How to cancel your Les Mills NZ membership — gym, Les Mills+ app, or class passes. Notice periods, minimum term, early exit fees, refunds and an email template.
intro: Cancelling a Les Mills membership in New Zealand is straightforward as long as you know which type of membership you hold and follow the right steps. Les Mills has three very different products — full club (gym) membership, the Les Mills+ on-demand app, and class passes — and each cancels differently. Club memberships have a 3-month minimum term and require written notice; the app cancels through your app store; class passes simply expire. This guide covers the process for each, the notice period, early-exit and medical waivers, suspension vs cancellation, and your rights under NZ consumer law.

Cancel only after written confirmation from Les Mills

sections.heading: First: Which Les Mills Membership Do You Have?
sections.body:
Les Mills sells three distinct products, and the cancellation method depends entirely on which you hold:

  • Club (gym) membership — physical access to a Les Mills club. This is the one with a 3-month minimum term and a direct debit. Cancel via the member portal or in person (see below).
  • Les Mills+ (on-demand app) — streaming workouts at home, billed as an app subscription. Cancel through your App Store or Google Play account, not at a club.
  • Class passes / casual passes — pre-paid bundles of class entries. These have no ongoing billing and simply expire, so there's usually nothing to cancel.

If you're being charged a fortnightly direct debit, you almost certainly have a club membership — read the gym-membership steps next.

sections.heading: How to Cancel a Les Mills Club (Gym) Membership
sections.body:
Step 1 — Check your minimum term. Les Mills club memberships have a 3-month minimum. If you've been a member for less than 3 months, you'll either pay out the remainder or wait until it ends. Log in to the member portal or call your club to confirm your start date.

Step 2 — Submit your cancellation. Two accepted methods: (1) online — log in to the Les Mills member portal at lesmills.co.nz, open membership settings and submit a cancellation request; or (2) in person — visit your home club and complete a cancellation form with staff. A casual phone call is not accepted as formal notice; if you email, send it to your specific home club and request written acknowledgement.

Step 3 — Serve the notice period. After the 3-month minimum, Les Mills requires 14 days written notice. You'll be billed for roughly two more weeks and keep access during that time.

Step 4 — Get written confirmation of your end date and final payment, and only then cancel your bank direct debit.

sections.heading: How to Cancel Les Mills+ (On-Demand App)
sections.body:
The Les Mills+ streaming app is billed as a normal app subscription, so you cancel it through whichever store you signed up with — not at a club and not via the member portal.

  • iPhone / iPad: Settings → tap your name → Subscriptions → Les Mills+ → Cancel Subscription.
  • Android: Google Play → profile icon → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Les Mills+ → Cancel.
  • Signed up on the web: log in at lesmills.com/plus, go to account/billing, and cancel there.

Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for. App-store subscriptions are not refunded for partial periods.

sections.heading: Cancelling During the 3-Month Minimum Term
sections.body:
To leave before the 3-month club minimum is up, you'll typically pay out the remaining weekly fees. Les Mills may waive this in specific circumstances:

  • Medical / injury — with a doctor's letter confirming you can't exercise.
  • Significant relocation — moving to an area with no Les Mills club.
  • Financial hardship / redundancy — at management discretion.

Contact your club's membership team directly to discuss — outcomes vary and are at the club's discretion.

sections.heading: Suspending vs Cancelling
sections.body: Going overseas, injured, or having a quiet period? Les Mills lets you suspend a club membership for a small weekly fee (typically a few dollars instead of your full rate). This pauses rather than ends the membership — your direct debit continues at the reduced rate and you keep your joining history, so you don't re-pay a joining fee later. A suspension is not a cancellation. Ask your club for current suspension terms and the maximum hold period.

sections.heading: Fees, Refunds & Your Rights Under NZ Consumer Law
sections.body:
Les Mills membership contracts are covered by NZ consumer law. Key points:

  • The 3-month minimum must have been clearly disclosed at signup. If a sales rep misrepresented the terms verbally, you may have grounds to challenge the contract under the Fair Trading Act.
  • Joining fees are non-refundable; the notice-period fortnight is still charged even if you don't attend.
  • Medical cancellations during the minimum term must be allowed for genuine medical reasons with a doctor's certificate.
  • If you're charged after your confirmed final payment date, request a refund and, if unresolved, raise a direct debit dispute with your bank.

sections.heading: Use This Cancellation Email Template
sections.body: Subject: Membership Cancellation — [Your Full Name] Dear Les Mills [Club], I am giving formal written notice to cancel my Les Mills club membership, effective at the end of my 14-day notice period (and after my 3-month minimum term, which ends [date]). Full name: [Name] Member number: [Number] Home club: [Club] Please confirm in writing my final payment date and membership end date. I will keep my direct debit active until that final payment has been processed. Kind regards, [Name] [Phone]

sections.heading: Mistakes to Avoid
list: Cancelling your direct debit before formal cancellation is confirmed — this creates a debt balance
Trying to cancel a club membership by casual phone call rather than the portal or in writing
Cancelling the app at a club, or trying to cancel a club membership via the app store — they're separate
Not accounting for the 14-day notice period in your timing
Assuming suspension equals cancellation — they're different
Not getting written confirmation — always request a cancellation confirmation email

faq.q: How do I cancel my Les Mills NZ club membership?
faq.a: Log in to the Les Mills member portal at lesmills.co.nz and submit a cancellation request, or complete a form in person at your home club. The minimum term is 3 months; after that you can cancel with 14 days written notice. Always get written confirmation.

faq.q: How do I cancel the Les Mills+ app?
faq.a: Les Mills+ is an app subscription, so cancel it where you signed up: iPhone via Settings → your name → Subscriptions; Android via Google Play → Subscriptions; or on the web at your lesmills.com account/billing page. You keep access until the paid period ends.

faq.q: What is the notice period for Les Mills NZ?
faq.a: For club memberships, 14 days written notice after your 3-month minimum term is complete. Submit through the member portal or in person — you'll be billed for that two-week notice window and keep access during it.

faq.q: Can I cancel Les Mills NZ before 3 months?
faq.a: Yes, but you'll typically pay out the remaining weeks of the 3-month minimum. Genuine medical reasons (with a doctor's certificate), relocation to an area with no Les Mills club, or financial hardship may be grounds for a waiver — contact your club directly.

faq.q: Will I be charged after I cancel?
faq.a: You'll be charged for the 14-day notice period even if you don't attend, then billing stops. You should not be charged after your confirmed final payment date — if you are, request a refund and, if needed, dispute the direct debit with your bank.

faq.q: Can I cancel Les Mills by phone?
faq.a: No — Les Mills club memberships require written notice. A casual phone call isn't accepted as formal notice. Cancel via the member portal, in person, or by written email to your home club and keep a copy.

faq.q: Do I need to cancel a Les Mills class pass?
faq.a: No. Class passes and casual passes have no ongoing billing — they simply expire after their validity period, so there's nothing to cancel and no direct debit to stop.
